title: Miklo Tha Kid - Dough (I Feel Like a Baker)
htmlContent:
Miklo Tha Kid's "Dough (I Feel Like a Baker)" is the perfect record at the perfect time. He doesn’t waste a single second creating an engaging experience for the listener to enjoy, with everything being done just right. He continues to deliver every release and continues to rise in this game. The songwriting is incredible and shows just how strong his pen gets with every release. The flow stands out in the verses and the production is captivating enough to be the perfect stage, for the show he puts on for his fans.
